segments.name: Wellness consumer products
segments.description: Develops and markets OTC and cosmetic wellness consumer products, including the Photocil narrow-band UV filter for vitiligo and psoriasis.
segments.evidence: The Company operates under one business segment.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company was separated from its then parent Safety Shot, Inc., which had previously acquired the Photocil assets from Applied Biology Inc. in 2022.
changes.evidence: Prior to the separation of the Company from its then parent (see Note – 9), the Company was included as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Safety Shot, Inc.
